title: hieracium amnicola
intro: Hieracium amnicola, commonly known as  marsh hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, due to its ability to scavenge free radicals. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium amnicola include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential treatment for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
